summary.en: NetZero Technology Ventures (founded 2021) is described as Israel's most active early-stage investor and venture builder in climate & energy deep-tech. Operating as an Israel Innovation Authority incubator from labs on the Bar-Ilan University campus in Ramat Gan, it provides up to $2M to early-stage deep-tech startups and is backed by TotalEnergies, Eren Groupe, Delek US and others.

summary.en: Doral Energy-Tech Ventures (2021) is the corporate VC arm of Israel's Doral Group, a global renewable-energy company. It launched with up to NIS 50 million (~$15.3M) to back early-stage renewable-energy and cleantech startups (solar, wind, biogas, storage, hydrogen, water), positioning itself as an early, non-controlling investor. Portfolio includes Yotta Energy, OxCCU and Phinergy.

summary.en: ESIL (Environmental Sustainability Innovation Lab), launched in 2020 in Haifa, is an Israel Innovation Authority-backed climate-tech incubator and venture lab — a joint venture of Bazan Group, EDF Renewables Israel and Johnson Matthey. The ~NIS 14M ($4M) lab funds up to 85% of a project's budget, to a ceiling of about NIS 1M (~$286K), to advance environmental and sustainability technologies toward a Net-Zero world.
